name: Maya Okafor
headline: CS student building fast, friendly tools for developers
about:
I'm a third-year Computer Science student at the University of Waterloo. I like making slow things fast and confusing things obvious.

Last summer I cut CI times by **38%** at a fintech startup. On weekends I maintain [quickdiff](https://github.com/example/quickdiff), a terminal diff viewer used by ~2k developers.
